# GrokSync

> Self-hosted private board so work context follows you across devices and agents.

- Version: 1.2.0
- License: MIT
- Code: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/groksync
- Site: https://groksync.jonbailey.xyz/

## What it is

A password-gated website you host. Continue packet, device stamps, handoff, optional encrypted notes.

## What it is not

A public hosted account. Not an installer or desktop app. You run your own instance in a browser.

## Continue packet

Last project, a one-line note, optional next step. Paths are slugs, never home directories.

## Setup

Clone the repo. Host it yourself. See README.
